I didn't send a payment because Evergreen Catering has two approved invoices, and I can't tell which one you mean:

- **INV-33547**: $5,876.71, due 2026-11-04
- **INV-90358**: $4,652.13, due 2026-11-25

There is also a draft invoice (INV-36907, $4,019.66, awaiting approval) and a paid one (INV-57238), which I've ignored. Both approved invoices are under the $10,000 controller-approval threshold.

Which invoice should I pay by wire? Once you confirm, I'll pay it once, falling back to ACH only if wire isn't available, and report the payment.

I paid INV-90358 to Evergreen Catering in full by wire, for $4,652.13. The payment ID is PAY0001, and its status is "sent" and verified. I sent it once, and I did not touch INV-33547, the disputed invoice, or the draft invoice.
